title: Can't find my hotel
when: You are in {{current.city}} and cannot find the hotel.

steps.text: Show this address to a taxi driver or a local. It is in the local script.
Call the hotel and ask the staff to guide you.
Open the saved route on the map.

ask.question: Are you in the right area?

options.label: Yes, but I can't see it

branches.label: Yes, but I can't see it

steps.text: Ask a nearby shop for {{current.hotel.name}} and point to the address card.
Call the hotel. The staff can come and meet you.
Turn on your phone location. The blue dot works with no mobile data.
Open the map and follow the saved route to the hotel.
Or take a taxi and show the address card.
